title: Cosmic Forge Sorceress
description: A blue-skinned sorceress with white markings stands behind a glowing anvil, channeling blue lightning-like energy from her hands into a key. She is surrounded by floating gears, an hourglass, cards, an open spellbook, coins, and mystical symbols in a ruined stone chamber under a swirling cosmic night sky filled with stars and nebulae.
prompt: A blue-skinned sorceress with white symbolic markings and glowing eyes stands behind a massive glowing anvil in a ruined stone chamber, channeling bright blue electrical energy from her outstretched hands into a large ornate key hovering above the anvil. Floating around her are large mechanical gears, an hourglass, playing cards, and mystical symbols. In the foreground lies an open ancient spellbook with diagrams, scattered coins, and a large golden astrolabe. The background shows a swirling cosmic night sky with purple and blue nebulae and stars, dramatic lighting, intricate details, fantasy surrealism style
